camel_example: aliyun iot BatchImportDevice --region cn-hangzhou --DeviceList.1.DeviceName device1 --DeviceList.1.DeviceSecret b4d43f700000010ba5e5 --DeviceList.1.Sn QC4000000001 --ProductKey a1BwAGV0000
description_en: Imports devices in batches to an MQTT instance or an MQTT cloud gateway product
description_zh: 调用该接口在MQTT型实例或MQTT云网关产品下批量导入设备
kebab_example: aliyun iot batch-import-device --product-key a1BwAGV0000 --device-list DeviceSecret=b4d43f700000010ba5e5 Sn=QC4000000001 DeviceName=device1 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: BatchImportDevice

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If the Overview page or the ID is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无实例概览页面或ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ProductKey of the cloud gateway product to which the devices belong
parameters.help_zh: 设备所属云网关产品的ProductKey
parameters.name: product_key

fields.help_en:
The name of the device.

The device name can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), underscores (_), at signs (@), periods (.), and colons (:), and must be 4 to 32 characters in length.

The device name must be unique within a product.

You can specify up to 10,000 device names in a single call. Data that exceeds this limit is discarded
fields.help_zh:
设备的名称。

设备名称支持英文字母、数字、短划线（-）、下划线（_）、at（@）、英文句号（.）和英文冒号（:），长度限制为4~32个字符。

设备名称在产品维度下不可重复。

单次调用该接口，最多能传入10,000个设备名称。超过该限制的数据会被丢弃
fields.name: device_name

fields.help_en:
The device secret.

The device secret can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), underscores (_), at signs (@), periods (.), and colons (:), and must be 1 to 32 characters in length.

You can specify up to 10,000 device secrets in a single call. Data that exceeds this limit is discarded
fields.help_zh:
设备的密钥。

设备密钥支持英文字母、数字、短划线（-）、下划线（_）、at（@）、英文句号（.）和英文冒号（:），长度限制为1~32个字符。

单次调用该接口，最多能传入10,000个设备密钥。超过该限制的数据会被丢弃
fields.name: device_secret

fields.help_en:
The serial number of the device.

The serial number can contain letters, digits, and underscores (_), and must be 1 to 64 characters in length.

You can specify up to 10,000 device serial numbers in a single call. Data that exceeds this limit is discarded
fields.help_zh:
设备的序列号。

序列号支持英文字母、数字和下划线（_），长度限制为1~64个字符。

单次调用该接口，最多能传入10,000个设备序列号。超过该限制的数据会被丢弃
fields.name: sn

parameters.help_en:
The list of devices to be imported in batches.

You can specify up to 10,000 devices in a single call. Data that exceeds this limit is discarded
parameters.help_zh:
待批量导入的设备列表。

单次调用该接口，最多能传入10,000个设备。超过该限制的数据会被丢弃
parameters.name: device_list
